name: Ripon Athletic
old_description: Ripon Athletic is a custom manufacturer of athletic apparel, uniforms and jackets. Our brands include Ripon Athletic uniforms and apparel, Ripon Jacket and the legendary Sand Knit brand. We are looking for people to help create top quality apparel to support our growth. We take pride in our 100% made in USA products. We offer competitive pay, health/dental/life insurance, paid holidays and vacations, 401K retirement plan, profit sharing and flexible scheduling.
about:
Ripon Athletic, based in Berlin, Wisconsin, has been manufacturing athletic apparel for over a century. The company was founded by Hank Derleth and operates under the Sand‑Knit, Ripon Athletic, and Ripon Jacket brands.

The company produces custom uniforms, award jackets, vinyl jackets, and accessories for teams at every level, from youth leagues to professional organizations. Manufacturing is done domestically in its Berlin facility, where the team handles custom pattern development, separate men’s and women’s fits, and extended sizing including shorts, oversizes, and longs.

Ripon Athletic serves the team‑sports market across youth, scholastic, and professional ranks. Its customers include team dealers, equipment managers, and athletic programs; testimonials cite professional equipment managers and dealers who rely on the company’s live customer‑service model.

The business emphasizes its 100 % U.S.‑made heritage and a service philosophy summed up by founder Hank Derleth’s “golden rule” approach: immediate live‑person support, custom flexibility, and a commitment to quality that has sustained the Sand‑Knit name for a hundred years.
